ai.description: This slender snake reaches 1 meter. It features a vibrant orange-red body with distinct black crossbands and two dark stripes along the head and neck. It has smooth scales and a glossy appearance.
ai.identificationRemarks: *Oreocryptophis porphyraceus* is uniquely identified by its vibrant, reddish-orange ground color overlaid with distinct, thin, dark-edged black transverse bands.
ai.habitat: This snake inhabits cool, humid montane forests and tea plantations in the Himalayas and Northeast India, typically at elevations between 800 and 2,500 meters.
ai.behavior: The Red Bamboo Trinket Snake is primarily crepuscular, often emerging at twilight to actively hunt small rodents and lizards across the forest floor or in low vegetation.
ai.reproductionNotes: *Oreocryptophis porphyraceus* is oviparous, laying clutches of 3–8 eggs. Breeding typically occurs from spring to early summer, with hatching in late summer or autumn.
ai.distributionRemarks: In the Indian subcontinent, *Oreocryptophis porphyraceus* inhabits the Eastern Himalayas and Northeast India, typically at elevations between 1,000 and 3,000 meters.
